title: Arm parity is measured: C's injected tokens include mid-session hook injections and stay at or below B's per row
body:
Source: S8 readiness audit 2026-11-19 (lead session); ADR 0021 points 10-11.
Evidence: evals/replay/arm-b.ts:43-46 counts C tokens without the hooks' mid-session injections; renderStatic can exceed the threshold by one record (arm-b.ts:80); 'C at no more injected tokens than B' (ADR 0021 point 7) is not checked per row.
Outcome: each C row records all injected tokens (session start, before edit, before Stop) from the exposure log, each B row its static tokens, and the report refuses (names the rows) when C > B; B's static set includes the Remember records C could serve.
Proof: a replay test where C's hook injections exceed B's static set fails the parity check naming the row.
